Issue #543: scalar wrongly captured by dictionary
Repository: python-poetry/tomlkit

Another on the theme of: output keys in the wrong order changing the meaning of the dictionary:
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3

import tomlkit


doc = tomlkit.loads("a.b = 1\n")
doc["a"]["c"] = {}
doc["z"] = 2

print(tomlkit.dumps(doc))
```
result
```
a.b = 1

[a.c]
z = 2
```
in which `z` is no longer a top-level key

```python
import tomlkit

def test_scalar_wrongly_captured_by_dictionary():
    doc = tomlkit.loads("a.b = 1\n")
    doc["a"]["c"] = {}
    doc["z"] = 2

    expected_output = """a.b = 1
z = 2

[a.c]
"""
    assert tomlkit.dumps(doc) == expected_output

```
